entries.52cc920494017aed: Through automobile sales and automobile recycling, the company has set out to strengthen its 'Value Chain Cross Mix Business', which maximizes the added value of products and services through collaboration that crosses divisional and corporate boundaries. In the Automobile Sales-Related Business, it identifies as challenges enhancing after-sales service for existing customers and promoting new store openings through multi-use stores; in the Automobile Recycling Business, it sets out raising brand awareness and promoting full material recycling.

entries.79a9950892edce56: In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers of the Automobile Sales-Related Business rose from the previous year to ¥37,513 million, while the Automobile Recycling Business fell below the previous year to ¥1,424 million. Solid performance in the Automobile Sales-Related Business offsets the decline in the Automobile Recycling Business, and the structure is one in which recycling continues, centered on sales.
